Description="#LabviewMVC\0A==========\0A\0AAn extensible HMVC implementation in LabVIEW\0A\0A##Why we care\0AThe idea of separating the UI from the bussines logic is not new (MVC its been around for a while)\0A...\0A\0A\0A\0A\0A##How To Use it\0AThe plan is to use VIPM to deliver the framework and the user will only need to create the application part and create childs of the 3 classes and override the required Methods. (this has not been verified)\0A\0AThe second option is to clone/download the framework and have on the side of your application.\0A\0A\0A\0A\0A##How is implemented\0A\0A\0A\0A###MODEL\0AThe model is only a placeholde class that has been included in the controller private data.\0AThe user should create a child class to implement their own code.\0A\0A\0A###VIEW\0A\0A\0A\0A###CONTROLLER\0A\0A\0A\0A##TO DO List\0A\0A\0A\0A"
